name: Mitochondrial Neurogastrointestinal Encephalomyopathy

criteria.description: Progressive gastrointestinal dysmotility with symptoms such as chronic diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, and abdominal pain
Diffuse leukoencephalopathy visible on brain MRI without significant clinical encephalopathy
Sensorimotor peripheral neuropathy confirmed by nerve conduction studies
Elevated plasma thymidine and deoxyuridine levels
Biallelic pathogenic mutations in the TYMP gene

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of gastrointestinal dysmotility, leukoencephalopathy on MRI, peripheral neuropathy, and confirmed biallelic TYMP mutations
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis can be supported by elevated plasma thymidine and deoxyuridine levels and muscle biopsy findings.

pathognomonic.notes: Includes chronic diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, and abdominal pain
Often asymptomatic or mild clinical encephalopathy
Symmetric distal weakness and sensory loss

common.notes: Due to malabsorption and gastrointestinal dysmotility
External ophthalmoplegia with limited eye movements

occasional.notes: Secondary to malnutrition or autonomic dysfunction

rare.notes: Rare but reported in some cases

laboratory: Lactic acidosis in blood and CSF
imaging: Diffuse symmetric leukoencephalopathy on brain MRI
genetic: Biallelic pathogenic variants in TYMP gene
other: Nerve conduction studies demonstrating sensorimotor neuropathy

redFlags: Rapidly progressive gastrointestinal dysmotility with severe weight loss
Diffuse leukoencephalopathy on MRI without significant clinical encephalopathy
Peripheral neuropathy with sensorimotor deficits in a young adult
references: Nishino I, Spinazzola A, Hirano M. Mitochondrial neurogastrointestinal encephalomyopathy (MNGIE): clinical features, biochemical diagnosis, and genetic basis. J Med Genet. 2000;37(7):493-495.
Hirano M, Nishino I. Mitochondrial neurogastrointestinal encephalomyopathy (MNGIE): an autosomal recessive disorder caused by thymidine phosphorylase mutations. Ann Neurol. 2001;49(2):123-127.
Garone C, Tadesse S, Hirano M. Clinical and genetic spectrum of mitochondrial neurogastrointestinal encephalomyopathy. Brain. 2011;134(Pt 6):3326-3332.
